dualshock4_config.tip:
Connecting
  1. Write the flow to the ESP32 (DS4 MAC can be left empty)
  2. Hold SHARE + PS on the DualShock4 until the light bar double-flashes
  3. The ESP32 pairs with it and shows DS4: connected xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx in the debug sidebar
  4. From then on, press PS to connect
To use only that controller, enter the shown address as DS4 MAC. See the help for details.
